name: usage-guard
description: Keeps a Claude Code subscription inside its weekly limit. Ships a price-weighted usage report built from the local transcripts (by kind, model, session and subagent), a read-only configuration doctor that flags plan-draining settings (effort, auto-compact window, subagent model, costly agent pins, prompt load, oversized CLAUDE.md, claude-mem provider) and a status line with four styles that shows context size, the 5-hour and 7-day limits and the burn pace against a linear week. Hooks deny tools and block prompts past a context limit (main session and subagents), cap subagent spawns per session and brief every subagent on its budget.
